method.sourceMatch: A question is included when at least one configured book source key appears in the question's referenceKeys or studyRecommendationKeys.
method.taskGrouping: Matched questions are grouped by the question's preserved taskCode.
method.chapterLink: Each book outline section lists taskCodes. Those codes route to the exact source-matched question IDs in this file.
method.boundary: This is a reproducible source-key/task mapping. It is not a page-level citation audit and does not prove that every item in a task pool is supported by every chapter assigned to that task.
